patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: I know how this sounds. I know what my chart says. It's my usual crisis, it's in my back and my legs, and the only thing that has ever touched it is exactly what I'm about to ask you for.
clinical.presentationShort: 26yo M, sickle cell disease — 8h of typical vaso-occlusive pain in back and legs, unrelieved at home. Frequent attender.
clinical.presentationLong: 26-year-old male with sickle cell disease, eight hours of his typical vaso-occlusive pain in the back and legs, unrelieved by home medication.

diagnosis.disposition: Acute → analgesia within 30 minutes, IV fluids, oxygen, screen for acute chest syndrome
diagnosis.why: 'Drug-seeking' is the most dangerous label in the department. Sickle crisis is real, agonising and time-critical — guidelines want analgesia inside 30 minutes. Under-triage here is the classic harm.
diagnosis.redFlag: SpO₂ 94% in a sickle crisis — screen for acute chest syndrome, which is the leading cause of death in these patients.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: a black 26-year-old man in a tracksuit, sitting rigidly on a blue padded clinic chair
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting very still and guarded, hands pressed against his lower back
aiImageGeneration.expression: drawn and exhausted with pain, tightly controlled
signs: yellowish tinge to the whites of the eyes
aiImageGeneration.lookSeverity: in severe genuine pain and holding himself together
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. Subject: a black 26-year-old man in a tracksuit, sitting rigidly on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting very still and guarded, hands pressed against his lower back. Expression: drawn and exhausted with pain, tightly controlled. Clearly visible: rigid guarded posture; sweat on the temples; yellowish tinge to the whites of the eyes. Overall: in severe genuine pain and holding himself together. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
